verdict.rationale: The evidence implies mise runs on macOS and Linux with one checked-in `mise.toml`. It shows a per-platform tool config table keyed by OS/arch (`macos-x64`) and bootstrap features that cover macOS defaults and Linux accounts. Nothing in the pack mentions Windows, and some features are explicitly limited to Linux and macOS (sandboxing) or Linux only (account management), so the same workflow everywhere is not established. Missing for 10: any evidence of Windows support (install, activation, shells such as PowerShell), explicit documentation that one config behaves identically across all three OSes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-OS use.
